en: The one this story follows. Son of a Brahmin noble of ancient India, handsome and keen of mind, he left home to seek peace of the heart, and his life rose and fell more than once.
zh: 本故事的主角。古印度婆罗门贵族之子，英俊聪慧，为求心灵安宁离家求道，一生几经沉浮。

en: The highest caste of ancient India—the Brahmin, hereditary priestly nobles who kept the sacrifices and the reciting of scripture
zh: 古印度最高种姓——婆罗门，世代掌管祭祀与诵读经典的祭司贵族

en: He could recite every scripture, and at sacrifice he served beside his father; the elders said he would be a priest among priests
zh: 背得出全部经文，献祭时替父亲执礼，长者们说他将来是祭司中的祭司

en: He had everything and could not be glad: he doubted that bathing, sacrifice, and scripture could give the heart true peace
zh: 拥有一切却无法快乐：他怀疑沐浴、祭祀与经典给不了内心真正的安宁

en: He made no quarrel; he only stood a night before his father's door. At daybreak the father yielded, and he said no further farewell
zh: 不吵不闹，只在父亲门前站了一夜；天亮时父亲让步，他一句道别也没有多说

en: A rich man of the city
He learned trade from the richest merchant of the great city, yet treated gain and loss as a game
zh: 跟随大城最富有的商人学做生意，却把盈亏当作一场游戏

en: Thinking, waiting, fasting—the three treasures he carried into the city from his years as a Samana
zh: 思想、等待、斋戒——他从沙门岁月带进城里的三件法宝

en: A house, servants, a room of fine clothes, and beyond the city a garden of mango trees
zh: 宅第、仆从、一屋子华服，城外还有一座种着芒果树的园子

en: The richer he grew, the more he feared losing, age, and death; at night he dreamed of money, and waking to the mirror found a stranger's face
zh: 越有钱越怕输、怕老、怕死；夜里会梦见金钱，醒来照镜子只见一张陌生的脸

en: Apprentice to the ferryman: poling, tilling, weaving baskets, learning from the river how to listen
zh: 渡口船夫的学徒：摇船、种田、编篮，向河水学习倾听

en: Thinking, waiting, fasting—only one still served: waiting for a child who would not own him
zh: 思想、等待、斋戒，如今只剩一样还用得上：等一个不肯认他的孩子

en: The day the son fled, he pursued as far as the garden gate at the city's edge, stood a long time, and at last knew he could not bring him back
zh: 儿子逃走那天，他一路追到城边的园门口，站了很久，终于明白追不回来

en: Among the river's thousand voices he heard at last the sound of perfection, and was reconciled with the whole world
zh: 在河水的万千声音里，他终于听见那个圆满之音，与整个世界和解

en: Siddhartha's closest friend and shadow. Loyal, shy, he sought the true way all his life, and later entered the Buddha's order.
zh: 悉达多的挚友与影子。忠诚、羞怯，一生都在追寻正道，后来皈依佛陀的僧团。

en: Shy, loyal, diligent; in all things he lagged half a step behind his friend, and he knew it
zh: 羞怯、忠诚、勤勉；凡事总落后朋友半步，他自己也知道这一点

en: He pressed forward to ask for a place, without waiting for his friend to speak first—the first step he ever took alone
zh: 他挤上前去请求收留，没有等朋友先开口——这是他生平第一次独立走出的一步

en: At dawn the next day he embraced the friend of his boyhood, tears falling on the other's shoulder, then turned and took his place in the line
zh: 第二天清晨，他抱了抱少年时代的朋友，眼泪落在对方肩上，然后转身入列

en: White-haired, he still wanders; he has sought a lifetime and still feels he has found nothing
zh: 白发苍苍仍在四处云游；找了一辈子，仍旧觉得自己什么也没有找到

en: Of everyone he asks, “Show me a path”; he has asked for decades, and has not thought that a path must be walked by oneself
zh: 见了谁都要问一句「请指点我一条路」，问了几十年，没想过路要自己走出来

en: He bent and kissed his old friend's brow. Tears fell on the boards of the boat, and he himself could not say why
zh: 他俯身吻了老友的额头，泪水落在船板上，自己也说不清是为什么

en: The Buddha, called the Blessed One. The awakened one of legend; he taught at Jetavana outside Savathi, and his disciples were many upon the earth.
zh: 佛陀，人称世尊。传说中的觉悟者，在舍卫城外的祇园精舍讲法，弟子遍布天下。

en: Men call him the Buddha, “the one who has awakened”; disciples and the faithful honour him as the Blessed One
zh: 人称佛陀，即「觉悟了的人」；弟子与信众都尊称他为世尊

en: His walking, the fall of his hands, the lowering of his gaze, all showed perfection; by that peace alone he could be known among hundreds of monks
zh: 走路、垂手、低眉都显着圆满，光凭这份安详就能从数百僧侣里被认出来

en: Four things: suffering, its arising, its cessation, and the path—life is suffering; suffering has a source; the source can be quenched; there is a way to quench it
zh: 苦、集、灭、道四条：生命是苦，苦有来处，来处能够熄灭，熄灭有路可走

en: Old as he was, he still walked from place to place to teach; the world began to say his time among men was short
zh: 年事已高仍在各地行脚说法，世人纷纷传说他已不久于人世

en: He left no wonders, but a path anyone might walk, and a company still walking it
zh: 他留下的不是神通，是一条人人可走的路，和一群继续走下去的人

en: The most beautiful courtesan of the great city. In ancient India a courtesan was a woman of means and art, independent; she was beautiful, clever, a teacher of the art of love.
zh: 大城中最美的名妓。古印度的名妓是有财有艺的独立女性，她美丽、聪明，是情爱之艺的导师。

en: She treated love as a craft that could be taught, knowing some thirty or forty ways; a pupil paid according to custom
zh: 她把情爱当作一门可以传授的技艺，熟知三四十种花样，学生须按规矩付学费

en: Through the curtain of her palanquin she glanced once at a barely clothed Samana, and judged him worth the making
zh: 隔着轿帘看一眼衣不蔽体的沙门，就断定这个人值得培养

en: She herself admitted she did not know how to love; those who can love are ordinary people, and that is their secret
zh: 她自己也承认不懂得爱人；能够爱的是平凡人，那是平凡人的秘密

en: The loved thing in the cage
She closed the garden gate, dismissed her guests, gave the garden beyond the city to the order, and set out with her son
zh: 闭了园门，遣散门客，把城外的花园献给僧团，带着儿子上路

en: The one she went to see
A black snake in the grass by the road bit her; she reached the ferry and could not rise again
zh: 路边草丛里一条黑蛇咬中了她，走到渡口便再也起不来了

en: She said she had meant to look once upon that holy one, and had found only the lover of former days, and that this too was well
zh: 她说本想去看那位圣者一眼，结果只找到旧日的情人，觉得这也一样好

en: The richest merchant of the great city, a friend of Kamala. Shrewd and anxious, he made trade his life.
zh: 大城最富有的商人，伽摩拉的朋友。精明而焦虑，把生意当作性命。

en: Hair gone grey, a shrewd and guarded look, a fleshy mouth, a walk that made a wind
zh: 斑白头发，精明而颇有城府的眼神，肉感的嘴唇，走起路来带风

en: A single shipment could keep him sleepless three nights; each year a new line marked his brow; he made trade his life
zh: 为一批货三夜合不上眼，额上一年添一道皱纹，把生意当作性命

en: What he never understood, all his life, was the man beside him who held everything in his hands and took none of it in earnest
zh: 他一辈子想不通的事，是身边有个人什么都握在手里，又什么都不当真

en: Ferryman at the crossing in the woods. An ordinary man who could not read, yet he knew best the art of listening—he had learned everything from the river.
zh: 林中渡口的船夫。不识字的普通人，却最懂得倾听的艺术——他从河水那里学会了一切。

en: An ageing ferryman, his face lined with fine smiling wrinkles, few of speech; when he smiled his eyes shone
zh: 上了年纪的摆渡人，满脸细细的笑纹，话极少，笑起来眼睛发亮

en: He would share bread, water, and mangoes with a traveller who had nothing, and did not press for the ferry-fee
zh: 肯把面包、水和芒果分给身无分文的过客，也不催着要船钱

en: He said the river had taught him: water flows out and returns; who ferries a man today will be repaid in time
zh: 他说这条河教过他：水流来流去终会回转，今日渡人，来日自有报答

en: To carry men across, and to hear them speak; among a thousand travellers, only four or five could hear the river talking
zh: 渡人过河，听人倾诉；千万过客里，只有四五个能听见河水说话

en: He had never read a scripture, and could speak no great doctrine, yet he had lived every word of it
zh: 他一辈子没读过经，说不出一句大道理，却把每一句道理都活了出来

en: His wife had died of illness many years before, and was burned on the mound beside the ferry; thereafter he kept the river alone
zh: 妻子许多年前病故，火化在渡口旁的土丘上；此后他一个人守着这条河

en: His teacher was the river: it taught him to listen, and that time does not exist in the world
zh: 他的老师是那条河：河水教他倾听，教他世上并不存在时间

en: He never spoke doctrine; he only brought a man to the water and sat with him—what is spoken is leftover rice; what is tasted is the meal
zh: 他从不讲道理，只把人带到水边一起坐着——讲出来的是剩饭，尝到的才是饭

en: When his friend had heard the sound of perfection, he walked into the woods and into the oneness of all things
zh: 等老友听见了圆满之音，他便步入林中，融入万物的圆融统一

en: Son of Kamala and Siddhartha, eight years old. Raised in wealth and indulged by his mother, proud and rebellious.
zh: 伽摩拉与悉达多的儿子，八岁。在富贵中被母亲惯大，骄纵而叛逆。

en: What he took when he fled
Eight years old, raised in a house of the great city, used to fine food and a soft bed, a servant running at the lift of a hand
zh: 八岁，在大城的宅子里长大，吃惯美食软床，一抬手就有仆人跑来

en: He would not work, he offended his elders, he smashed the rice bowl, and took his father's patience for the most hateful of devices
zh: 拒绝做工，冒犯长辈，摔碎米饭碗，把父亲的宽容当成最可恨的手段

en: He broke the oar, rowed across, and went toward the city; thereafter no one spoke of where he was
zh: 他折断船桨，划船过了河，往大城去了；此后再没有人提起他的下落

en: Siddhartha's father, an honoured Brahmin priest. His bearing was calm and noble; he loved his son deeply, and could not keep him.
zh: 悉达多的父亲，可敬的婆罗门祭司。举止从容高贵，深爱儿子却留不住他。

en: His bearing was calm and noble; he never raised his voice; the whole town believed his life lacked nothing
zh: 举止从容高贵，说话从不高声；全城的人都以为他此生再无缺憾

en: Three times in the night he rose and saw his son still standing outside the door; at daybreak he said: Go, go into the woods
zh: 他半夜三次起身，看见儿子还站在门外；天亮时他说：去吧，去林子里

en: The eldest Samana in the forest of austerities, nearly sixty and still without Nirvana. Severe, quick to anger.
zh: 苦修林中最年长的沙门，近六十岁仍未证得涅槃。严厉、易怒。

en: Nearly sixty, he had practised in the woods a lifetime, and still had not arrived where he meant to go
zh: 年近六十，在林中修了一辈子，仍旧没有抵达他要去的那个地方

en: When two disciples would leave, he raged; one of them held his eyes, and he bowed instead and blessed them
zh: 两个弟子要走，他大发雷霆；被其中一个盯住眼睛，反倒躬身为他们祝福

en: The house where Siddhartha was born and grew. Courtyard, hall of scripture, and the sacrificial fire—a Brahmin priest's dwelling.
zh: 悉达多出生与长大的家。庭院、经堂与祭火，婆罗门祭司的宅第。

en: Stone steps on the riverbank at the town's edge. Brahmins bathe here each day, praying to be washed of sin.
zh: 城边的河岸石阶。婆罗门每天在此沐浴净身，祈求洗清罪孽。

en: The bathing place by the river
The high caste bathe here each day, reciting prayers, asking to be washed of sin
zh: 高种姓每天在此沐浴净身，念诵祷词，祈求洗清罪孽

en: In boyhood he came each day and completed the whole office, until one day he doubted that water washed anything away
zh: 少年时他每天来做完整套功课，直到有一天怀疑水洗不掉什么

en: The great banyan beyond the town. Two boys often sat in its shade to meditate, murmuring the syllable Om.
zh: 城外的大榕树。两个少年常在树荫下打坐冥想，默念「唵」字真言。

en: The friend who swore beneath the tree
The great banyan beyond the town, its aerial roots hanging to the ground; under its shade it was cool the year round
zh: 城外那棵大榕树，气根一直垂到地上，树荫底下常年凉快

en: Two boys often sat here and murmured the holy sound; here too one of them said that he would go
zh: 两个少年常在这里打坐默念圣音；也是在这里，其中一个说出了要走

en: The jungle where the Samanas dwelt. Here the ascetics tempered themselves with hunger, the sun, and thorns.
zh: 沙门们栖身的丛林。在这里，苦行者以饥饿、暴晒与荆棘磨炼自己。

en: The great city where the Buddha stayed and taught. Every house was willing to fill a monk's bowl with food.
zh: 佛陀驻锡讲法的大城。城里家家都愿意给僧侣的钵盂盛满饭食。

en: Jetavana—the grove monastery a rich merchant bought and gave to the Buddha. Monks gathered there like a little town.
zh: 祇树给孤独园——富商买下献给佛陀的园林精舍。僧侣云集，像一个小市镇。

en: A wealthy elder bought the whole grove and gave it to the holy one he followed, and to the order
zh: 一位富有的长者买下整片园林，献给他所信奉的圣者与僧团

en: Deep shade, monks as numerous as cloud, like a little town: some sat silent in stillness, some argued fiercely
zh: 园里浓荫蔽日、僧侣如云，像一座小市镇：有人默坐入定，有人激烈论辩

en: The ferryman's little hut by the river. Travellers may sleep there; inside are bread, water, and mangoes.
zh: 船夫的河边小草屋。过客可以借宿，屋里有面包、水和芒果。

en: The prosperous city where Siddhartha sank for many years. Shops, gaming, feasts—the playground of the world.
zh: 悉达多沉沦多年的繁华大城。商铺、赌局、宴饮——尘世的游乐场。

en: Kamala's garden villa beyond the city. Trees and flowers in plenty; deep in the pavilion hung a little golden cage.
zh: 伽摩拉城外的园林别墅。花木葱茏，亭子深处挂着一只小小的金笼。

en: A garden villa beyond the city, trees and flowers in plenty; deep in the pavilion hung a little golden cage
zh: 城外的园林别墅，花木葱茏，亭子深处挂着一只小小的金笼

en: By the road outside the garden a Samana grey with dust once stood a long time, only to see clearly the one in the palanquin
zh: 园门外的路边，一个满身尘土的沙门曾站了很久，只为看清轿中的人

en: The living thing in the garden
To whom, in the end, the garden was given
Kamaswami's great house. Carpets, counting-room, and storehouses; money flowed in and out here.
zh: 湿瓦弥的豪宅。地毯、账房与仓库，金钱从这里流进流出。

en: Stone steps on the city's watercourse. Barber-helpers tout for custom here; at night small boats rest.
zh: 大城边河道的石阶。理发帮工在此招揽客人，夜里有小船栖身。

en: A coconut palm at the river's bend. Someone once looked down into the water here, with death only a line away.
zh: 大河转弯处的一棵椰子树。有人曾在这里俯视水波，与死只隔一线。

en: The ferry where Vasudeva plied. A boat, a hut, forest on both banks; here the river sings day and night.
zh: 维稣德瓦摆渡的渡口。一条船、一间草舍、两岸的森林，河在这里日夜歌唱。

en: A boat, a hut, forest on both banks without end; here the river sings day and night
zh: 一条船、一间草舍、两岸望不到头的森林，河水在这里日夜歌唱

en: Those going to market, to a burial, fleeing debt, on pilgrimage—all must board here; the river asks nothing
zh: 赶集的、奔丧的、逃债的、朝圣的都要在此上船，河水一句也不多问

en: The burning-ground by the water near the ferry. The ferryman's dead wife was burned here; later she too came to rest here.
zh: 渡口附近临水的火化场。船夫的亡妻在此火化，后来她也归寂于此。

en: The rare songbird Kamala kept in a little golden cage. It sang each morning, like her spring that would not age.
zh: 伽摩拉养在小小金笼里的珍稀歌鸟。它每天清晨歌唱，像她不老的春天。

en: Each morning it sang sweetly; its mistress took it for her spring that would not grow old
zh: 每天清晨婉转歌唱，主人拿它当作自己不会老去的春天

en: In the dream it lay stiff on the floor of the cage and was thrown into the road—in that same instant the dreamer's heart was wrung
zh: 梦里它僵直地躺在笼底，被扔到路上——同一刻，做梦的人心像被绞住

en: Dice of the gaming table. In the years of sinking, the anxiety of a great stake was the only heartbeat he still felt.
zh: 赌局上的骰子。沉沦岁月里，一掷千金的焦虑是他唯一还感觉得到的心跳。

en: Great sums on a throw; thousands won, thousands lost again in a breath; even the country villa was staked
zh: 一掷千金，赢了成千上万，转手又输掉成千上万，连乡下别墅也押上去

en: He did not love money; only the anxiety of a stake not yet decided could make him feel he was still alive
zh: 他并不爱钱；只有赌金悬而未决的那种焦虑，能让他觉得自己还活着

en: The master who watched him stake everything
The wooden boat and bamboo raft at the crossing. To carry men over the river is the ferryman's living, and the bridge between the banks.
zh: 渡口的木船竹筏。载人过河，是船夫的营生，也是两岸之间的桥。

en: Wooden boat and bamboo raft, carrying men across—the ferryman's living, and the only bridge between the banks
zh: 木船与竹筏，载人过河，是船夫的营生，也是两岸之间唯一的桥

en: Years ago it carried a young Samana who had nothing; the ferryman took no money from him
zh: 许多年前它载过一个身无分文的年轻沙门，船夫没有收他的钱

en: The long oar of the ferry, its handle worn bright. After the child fled, it was not seen again.
zh: 摇渡船的长桨，桨柄被磨得发亮。孩子逃走后，它再也没有出现。

en: The first decent garment the courtesan gave the young Samana. He carried it out of the garden under his arm.
zh: 名妓赠给年轻沙门的第一件体面衣服。他挟着它走出花园。

en: The yellow garment worn by the Buddha's disciples. To put it on is to leave household, wealth, and the old self.
zh: 佛陀弟子穿的黄衣。披上它，就意味着告别家庭、财富与旧我。

en: The bowl in which monks beg their food. One meal a day; even the Buddha himself entered the city with his bowl at dawn.
zh: 僧侣乞食的钵。一天只进一餐，连佛陀本人清晨也持钵入城。

en: The fan Kamala turned in her hands. When she smiled and asked a question, the eye-spots on the leaf flashed.
zh: 伽摩拉手中把玩的羽扇。她笑着提问时，扇面的眼斑一闪一闪。

en: The garden of her who held the fan
The leaf was set with the eye-spots of peacock plumes, flashing as it moved, like many eyes blinking at once
zh: 扇面缀着孔雀翎的眼斑，一晃一闪，像许多只眼睛同时眨

en: When she smiled and asked, she half hid her mouth with it; only those who answered well saw her smile
zh: 她笑着提问时用它半掩住嘴，答得好的人才看得见她的笑

en: A little basket of two colours, woven of bark, where the two ferrymen kept the ferry-money. Later it vanished with the child.
zh: 树皮编的双色小篮，两位船夫存船费的地方。后来随孩子失踪。

en: Highest of the castes of ancient India: hereditary priests and scholars, keepers of sacrifice and scripture, who held themselves nearest the gods.
zh: 古印度种姓中最高的一级：世袭的祭司与学者，掌管祭祀与经典，自认最近神明。

en: Bathing at daybreak, sacrifice and recitation at morning and evening; the hours of a day were all cut by prayer
zh: 天亮沐浴净身，晨昏献祭诵经，一天的时辰全由祷词分成段落

en: Father taught son, son taught grandson; a Brahmin child, from the first memory, could speak the most sacred syllable
zh: 父亲教儿子，儿子教孙子；婆罗门的孩子记事起就会念最神圣的那个音节

en: Wandering ascetics who had left the household. Naked and hungry, they sought release by extreme austerity, despised and revered by the world.
zh: 离弃家庭的游方苦行者。赤身忍饥，以极端苦行寻求解脱，被世人既鄙夷又敬畏。

en: Fasting, the bearing of pain, the sun, sitting still; driving the self out of the body again and again, and watching it return
zh: 斋戒、忍痛、暴晒、静坐；把自我一次次赶出身体，再看它一次次回来

en: To think, to wait, to fast—later, in the city, these three were worth more than a boat of goods
zh: 会思想、会等待、会斋戒——这三样后来在城里比一船货物还值钱

en: The “true Self” in Brahmin teaching: the undying essence in the depth of each person, one with the spirit of the world.
zh: 婆罗门教义中的「真我」：每个人内心深处永恒不灭的本质，与宇宙之灵合一。

en: The undying essence in the depth of each person; it is said to have been, from the first, one with the spirit of the world
zh: 每个人内心深处永恒不灭的本质，据说与宇宙之灵原本就是一个

en: Scripture says it is in the heart, yet no one can point to where; the harder one hunts, the more one loses oneself
zh: 经文说它就在心里，谁也指不出它在哪儿；越是拼命去找，越是把自己弄丢

en: The most sacred syllable, the word that begins and ends Brahmin prayer, meaning “perfection.” To murmur it is as if the heart were an arrow aimed at Brahman.
zh: 最神圣的音节，婆罗门祷文的起止之字，意为「圆满」。默念它时，如以心为箭指向梵天。

en: The word that begins and ends Brahmin prayer, meaning “perfection”; a child could speak it from the first memory
zh: 婆罗门祷文的起止之字，意思是「圆满」，孩子记事起就会念

en: In the instant of despair by the river, it was this syllable, long asleep, that woke him—and the thousand voices of the river, at last, became this one word
zh: 在河边绝望的刹那，正是这个沉睡多年的音节把他唤醒——万千河声，最终也汇成这一个字

en: Life turning between birth and death, like a wheel that does not stop. Those not yet awake suffer craving and pain again and again in Samsara.
zh: 生命在生死之间循环流转，如车轮不停。未证悟的人在轮回中反复经历渴望与痛苦。

en: Life turning between birth and death, like a wheel that does not stop; craving follows pain, pain follows craving
zh: 生命在生死之间循环流转，如车轮不停；渴望接着痛苦，痛苦接着渴望

en: How it looked in the city
Feasts, gaming, buying and selling, love—the days turned and turned, and a man still thought he was walking forward
zh: 宴饮、赌局、买卖、情爱，日子转过一圈又一圈，人还当自己在往前走

en: What keeps the wheel turning is craving: the thing wanted, once in the hand, and a new wanting grows at once
zh: 推着轮子不停转的是渴望：想要的东西一到手，新的想要立刻又长出来

en: The meaning is quenching: the still realm beyond birth and death. The aim of the Buddha's teaching, the farther shore of the sea of pain.
zh: 熄灭之意：超越生死轮回的寂静境界。佛陀教义的目标，苦海的对岸。

en: The elder who sought it and did not arrive
The meaning is quenching: the still realm beyond the turning of birth and death, the aim the Buddha's teaching points toward
zh: 熄灭之意：超越生死流转的寂静境界，是佛陀教义所指的目标

en: Austerity, fasting, hypnosis cannot reach it; some practise a lifetime and still stand on this shore
zh: 苦行、斋戒、催眠都到不了那里；有人修了一辈子，仍旧站在此岸

en: The company of wandering monks who followed the Buddha: yellow robes, the alms bowl, the precepts, travelling the four directions.
zh: 追随佛陀的游方僧人群体：披黄衣、持钵乞食、守戒云游四方。

en: One of the three arts of the Samanas: to bear hunger in order to master desire, and so not be driven by hunger.
zh: 沙门三大技艺之一：忍饥挨饿以降伏欲望，因此不被饥饿驱赶。

en: The high courtesan of ancient India: a woman of means and art, choosing her own companions, known for song, dance, and the art of love.
zh: 古印度的高级艺妓：有财有艺、自主择偶的独立女性，以歌舞与情爱之艺闻名。

en: Not a woman to be bought, but an independent person with land, with guests, who chose her lovers herself
zh: 不是可以买卖的女子，而是有田产、有门客、自己挑选情人的独立人物

en: One who came to learn must first have decent clothes, shoes, and money; a pupil brought the fee according to custom
zh: 求教的人须先有像样的衣裳、鞋子和钱，学生要按规矩把学费送到

en: The first gift she gave him
The sacred scriptures handed down among the Brahmins, source of sacrifice and wisdom, including the Upanishads.
zh: 婆罗门世代传承的神圣经典，祭祀与智慧的源泉，含《奥义书》。
